blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas stayed alive for a Final Four berth after easing past Adamson, 76-63, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday night at Mall of Asia Arena. With their season on the line, the Growling Tigers banked on big man Collins Akowe, who delivered 21 points and 10 rebounds, while Mark Llemit added 16 points. ended their elimination round at 8-6, putting Far Eastern University (8-5) and defending champion La Salle (8-5) in jeopardy of making the semifinals.
